recorded: Two anyps5-retro-host processes from B-Howell/anyps5-retro-host netplay-design 9b75364, built on Windows with WinLibs GCC 15.2, running SwanStation 631f0fb on OpenBIOS and the psyqo hello disc, driven by that repository's tests/lockstep_test.py --frames 600.
